# Dependencies

<!-- generated by build/deps.ts write from deps/registry.json; do not edit -->

Every third-party input we build, run or ship, and the host tools we rely on. The policy and
the provenance bar are in [ADR supply-chain provenance](adr/20261104-supply-chain-provenance.md);
`./seclab lint deps` fails if a pin in the tree is missing here, or an entry is stale.

Bar: **signed-verified** (publisher signature or attestation, verified before use);
**official-pinned** (digest or hash from the project's own source, checksums verified where
published); **built-from-source** (by us, from pinned source); **exception** (EDR, user-approved).

| docker:29-cli | official-pinned | Docker Official Images are not signed. |
| lycheeverse/lychee 0.24.2 | official-pinned | No signature available. Proposed: re-pin to a release whose binary attestation verifies and run that binary in our pinned base, or build from the tagged source. |
| rhysd/actionlint:1.7.12 | official-pinned | Attested binary exists but the image is not attested. Proposed: run the attested release binary (gh attestation verify --owner rhysd) in our pinned base. |
| ghcr.io/sigstore/cosign/cosign v3.0.3 | official-pinned | The verifier's own signature isn't verified yet; check its release bundle (gh attestation / cosign verify-blob on the release binary) and pin that. |
| ghcr.io/gitleaks/gitleaks v8.30.1 | official-pinned | Gates a security control with no provenance. Proposed: build from the v8.30.1 tag (git, commit verified) in our attested CI and pin our image. |
| Docker Sandboxes (sbx) and its shell kit | official-pinned | Kit provenance unconfirmed; check sbx kit verify for Docker's own kits. |
